messages:
Maya (PM): Quick kickoff — we need to winnow the observability launch surface for GA. Customer asks keep coming: per-tenant cost, trace hooks for high-latency tails, and grouped error analytics. Can we align scope today?
Sam (Eng): +1. My big concern is perf impact of tracing hooks at 99.9p. Need to decide sampling vs targeted instrumentation.
Jordan (SRE): Agree. If we do broad tracing we risk 2x IO on sidecars. Prefer targeted hooks + async export.
Lee (Data): For cost breakdown, we can do a coarse per-route token-cost % first, then iterate to per-tenant next quarter. Data pipeline for per-request attribution exists but needs sampling.
Ruth (Customer Success): Customers repeatedly ask for per-customer cost view and top error groups. If we can show a lightweight per-tenant card in Console that would unblock a bunch of sales.
Maya (PM): Proposal for GA-minimum (3 pillars): dashboards (ops + cost + errors), tracing hooks (canary hooks for top 5 slow endpoints), cost breakdown (route-level % + quick per-tenant card), error analytics (grouping by stack tag + counts). Thoughts?
Sam (Eng): That feels reasonable. Implementation notes:
```
- Tracing hooks: attach span hooks at router + model runner boundary
- Sampling: 1% global + 100% on error responses for the 5 endpoints
- Export: async to observability pipeline (no sync writes on hot path)
```
Jordan (SRE): Add to that: circuit-breaker for tracing export to avoid cascading when pipeline is down. Also retention defaults: 14d for traces, 90d for aggregates.
Lee (Data): Cost breakdown accuracy tradeoff: route-level token accounting uses inference logs + model cost table. Expect ~5-10% variance initially. We should flag that in UI.
Ruth (Customer Success): If we add a prominent "estimated accuracy" tooltip that helps sales. Also request a sample CSV export for customers.
Maya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria (quick):
```
- Ops dashboard shows latency p50/p95/p99 for top routes
- Cost card: route % + per-tenant card (estimated) visible in Console
- Tracing: instrument top 5 endpoints with targeted spans + error capture
- Error analytics: group by exception type + show top 10 traces for each group
- No observable >5% CPU increase on serving hosts in perf test
```
Sam (Eng): Can own tracing + perf gate. ETA: spike + perf run in 2 sprints.
Jordan (SRE): I'll run the perf tests and define the SLO rollback condition for tracing.
Lee (Data): I can ship the first-cost-card prototype (backend + thin UI) by end of sprint. Accuracy tooltip text: short note + link to docs.
Ruth (Customer Success): I'll compile top-8 customer asks and send a one-pager for the launch notes.
Maya (PM): Okay owners assigned: Sam tracing, Jordan perf gating, Lee cost card, Ruth customer comms. Next sync: Thurs 9am. Any blockers?
Sam (Eng): Need infra quota for async exporter (kafka topic) — filing ticket.
Jordan (SRE): Added an alert template for exporter failures to the runbook.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: obs-instrumentation/spike -> staging at 2025-04-11T18:00Z :rocket:
Ruth (Customer Success): :thumbsup: from customer side on minimal scope. If we can demo per-tenant cost and error groups, we're golden.
Maya (PM): Great. I'll update the roadmap doc and create the acceptance checklist in GH. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
